description: Canonical usage-optimized Codex model-profile routing policy. Luna handles bounded high-volume work, Sol handles work requiring broader judgment, and Astra is reserved for explicit escalation. Logical profiles are resolved only by scripts/ops/model-routing.ts and scripts/ops/codex-exec.ts.

verified_against.verification_method: Official OpenAI model-selection and Codex configuration documentation plus the installed Codex 0.153.3 model catalog and live model acceptance smoke test. The signed-in ChatGPT account rejects gpt-6-luna for Codex CLI, so executable efficient profiles use the supported 5.6 Luna/Sol slugs; GPT-6 Astra remains a disabled escalation.

codex-luna-low.description: Lowest-cost profile for narrow, deterministic T2 work. Select explicitly when the packet is small and verification is straightforward.

codex-luna-medium.description: Default profile for normal clear-scope T2 implementation from a complete work packet.

codex-sol-medium.description: Balanced profile for everyday coding that needs judgment. Default for guarded T1 lanes and complex T2 lanes.

codex-sol-high.description: Explicit escalation for rescue, deep analysis, or verification after the medium profile is insufficient. It is never a tier default.

codex-astra-medium.description: Frontier escalation only. Disabled until a trusted external authorization mechanism can prove explicit approval; caller-supplied override text cannot unlock it.

codex-terra-medium.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for existing operator commands. New manifests must use codex-luna-medium.

codex-sol-max.description: Deprecated and unavailable. Use codex-sol-high, or the separately governed codex-astra-medium escalation.

legacy_compatibility.description: Schema-version-1 manifests without model_routing resolve to the current low-cost T2 default for that execution only. Schema-version-2 manifests still fail closed when model_routing is absent.
